Because a título propio has no Distrito Único preinscripción, there is no external calendar to fall back on either.
notes: ⚠️ THIS IS THE ONE NON-OFFICIAL PROGRAMME IN THIS BATCH OF NINE, and it is exactly the case the brief warns about: an official-looking 'Máster' at a university-affiliated school, marketed with a 'Titulación oficial por la Universidad Rey Juan Carlos' banner, that its own fact sheet labels 'Título Propio'. Industry links are genuinely strong (Sony Music / Sony Music Publishing pitching and composition camp, MercaderLab, Sonobox; AVID Pro Tools 101/110 certification embedded), which is why the programme is attractive despite the status — record that trade-off rather than the status alone. NOT FOUND on this record: tuition, rates year, application dates, entry requirements.

(TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', Nivel MECES 3, Máster RD 1393/2007, verificación 23/07/2014, BOE 18/10/2014 y 25/01/2018, Resolución Favorable para la Renovación de la Acreditación 23/07/2018. The programme's own acceso page states verbatim that it is the 'Master que habilita para el ejercicio de la profesión de Ingeniero de Telecomunicación' under Orden CIN/355/2009 — i.e. it confers a REGULATED PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATION, the only such title in this batch. ects: 90 (RUCT: 60 obligatorios + 0 optativos + 0 prácticas + 30 TFM). It is not a machine translation of a Spanish plan — it is UJA's own bilingual description with an explicit language column — but no separate Spanish-language 'idioma de impartición' string was located, so it is recorded as the university's own statement rather than as a quote from the Spanish memoria. LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS, both directions: (a) from the Spanish acceso page, verbatim — 'Los estudiantes que cursen este Máster deberán acreditar, como requisito para la matriculación, la competencia lingüística en inglés de nivel B1 o superior'; (b) from the programme page — 'Proficient knowledge of English language (e.g. TOEFL 200 CB, 75 iBT, IELTS 5.5; Cambridge FCE). Basic Spanish language skills (Level A1). You may apply before having passed your Level A1 certificate.' ⚠️ SPANISH A1 ONLY, AND YOU MAY APPLY BEFORE OBTAINING IT — the lowest Spanish bar found anywhere in this batch, and directly relevant to a candidate at A0/A1.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 1,135.80 — 12.62 EUR/ECTS x 90 = 1,135.80. Applies to BOTH populations. The 12.62 EUR/credit figure is the Andalusian first-enrolment rate for a MÁSTER HABILITANTE, which the Junta has equated to the grado rate; non-habilitante Andalusian masters pay 13.68 EUR/credit, so being habilitante saves this candidate about EUR 95 over the 90 credits. This is the cheapest programme in the batch. ⚠️ On top of that, Andalucía applies 'la bonificación por rendimiento académico, que implica la compensación del 99% del coste de los créditos aprobados en primera matrícula' — credits passed at first attempt are compensated at 99%, so the effective net cost can fall far below the headline figure. I did NOT confirm whether a non-EU non-resident student qualifies for that bonificación; Decreto 98/2023 art. 12 sets no explicit nationality exclusion but the criteria reference prior enrolment in Andalusian public institutions. Treat the bonificación as UNVERIFIED for this candidate. Additional known fee: EUR 176.00 for issuing the official título.
tuition_population: non-EU — and identical to EU/resident (see non_eu_surcharge)
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 rates, currently in force. Set by Decreto 98/2023 de 2 de mayo (BOJA nº 84) as modified by Decreto 142/2025 de 2 de septiembre (BOJA nº 172), which applies 'a partir del curso académico 2025-2026'. Andalucía has repeatedly frozen these prices, but NO separate 2026-27 or 2027-28 decree figure was located — do not assume the figure carries forward to a September 2027 intake without checking.
non_eu_surcharge: NO — but with an important caveat about how it was sourced, and a live legal risk. UJA's own FAQ 'Si soy estudiante extranjero o extranjera, ¿Qué precio tengo que pagar por la matrícula?' answers that international students pay THE SAME public prices as students of Spanish nationality, even without resident status. ⚠️ PROVENANCE: that UJA page currently returns HTTP 500 on every fetch (WebFetch and curl alike); this answer was obtained from the SEARCH INDEX, not read on the primary page — 'source_access: search index — page returns HTTP 500, not directly fetched'. NEEDS A HUMAN TO OPEN IT IN A NORMAL BROWSER. ⚠️ LIVE RISK: Decreto 98/2023 art. 3.2 EXPRESSLY PERMITS Andalusian universities to raise prices for non-EU non-resident students by up to 100% of the cost of the service. Andalucía is therefore one of the communities the brief warns about, where the decree authorises rather than fixes the non-EU price — so the real figure must come from UJA's own tariff, and UJA's own tariff page is the one that is down. The decree text itself contains no non-EU price. Current best answer: no surcharge levied by UJA, sourced from the search index only.
complementary_credits_required: TWO ANSWERS. (a) FOR THE TITLE, from RUCT: 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0 — no bridging credits built into the title. (b) FOR THE APPLICANT, from UJA's own 'Acceso, Matrícula, Apoyo y Complementos' page: complementos ARE imposed on specific profiles. Access is open to whoever has previously acquired the competences set out in Orden CIN/355/2009; holders of an Ingeniería Técnica de Telecomunicación must take complementos to reach '48 créditos ECTS en tecnologías específicas de telecomunicación requeridas', taken 'en el Grado de Ingeniería Telemática o en el Grado de Ingeniería de Tecnologías de Telecomunicación'. ⚠️ FOR THIS CANDIDATE: a Software Engineering degree is NOT a telecommunications degree, so the CIN/355/2009 competence test is the binding gate and complementos of up to 48 ECTS of specific telecom technologies are a realistic outcome — that would roughly halve the value of the 300-ECTS advantage. This is the single biggest risk on this record and NEEDS AN INDIVIDUAL RULING from the Comisión Académica. FAVOURABLE COUNTERWEIGHT, quoted verbatim from the same page: holders of degrees from outside the EHEA may access 'sin necesidad de la homologación' — no homologation of the Tunisian degree is required. UJA also publishes a separate 'Reconocimiento de créditos' page for this master, the natural route for the 300-ECTS question; its contents were not read.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. Admission is NOT handled by the university: preinscripción and place allocation are centralised by the DISTRITO ÚNICO ANDALUZ (DUA, https://lajunta.es/portaldua); one application covers all Andalusian public universities and may list up to six masters in order of preference. Full DUA calendar for curso 2026/2027 (marked 2026-27, NOT shifted forward): ⚠️ PRIMERA FASE — RESERVED FOR ESTUDIANTES EXTRANJEROS: solicitudes 'Desde el día 13 a lo largo del día al 29 de enero de 2026'; Lista 1 19 febrero (reclamaciones 19–24 feb, pago 20–24 feb); Lista 2 12 marzo (reclamaciones 12–17 marzo, pago 13–17 marzo); Lista 3 9 abril (reclamaciones 9–14 abril, pago 10–14 abril). SEGUNDA FASE (españoles y extranjeros): solicitudes 17–26 junio 2026; Lista 1 22 julio (reclamaciones 22–24 julio, matrícula 23–27 julio); Lista 2 14 septiembre (reclamaciones 14–16 sept, matrícula 15–17 sept); resultas 29 sept, 9 oct, 20 oct, 28 oct. TERCERA FASE (españoles y extranjeros): solicitudes 8–15 septiembre 2026; Lista 1 29 septiembre; Lista 2 9 octubre; resultas 20 y 28 octubre. NON-EU EARLY ROUND: YES, EXPLICITLY — the Primera Fase exists for foreign students and runs in JANUARY, five months before the general round. For a September 2027 intake the equivalent window would fall in January 2027, which is the earliest hard deadline of any programme in this batch.
notes: RUCT code confirmed from the RUCT deep link and output/ruct-detail.jsonl; UJA holds exactly one Ingeniería de Telecomunicación master, so no sibling ambiguity, and the register's 90-ECTS figure matches the programme page's 60+30 split. The programme's own pages do not print a 'Código RUCT'. ⚠️ THREE UJA PAGES ARE SERVER-BROKEN (HTTP 500) and blocked verification: the extranjeros price FAQ, /estudios/acceso-y-matricula/matricula/precios-publicos and /estudios/acceso-y-matricula/precios-publicos-y-formas-de-pago. The per-credit figure therefore comes from the Junta de Andalucía (the price-setting authority) rather than from UJA's own tariff page — acceptable for a regional public price, but the non-EU question specifically needs UJA's tariff, which is exactly what is unreachable. LIST FOR gaps.md. EXTRA FINDING not asked for but material: EPS Linares runs a DUAL DEGREE with Technische Hochschule Mittelhessen (Germany) — one semester at THM, one at Linares. Fee arithmetic shown: 12.62 x 90 = 1,135.80. Overall this record is the cheapest and the most language-accessible of the nine, and simultaneously carries the largest unresolved eligibility risk (CIN/355/2009 competences and up to 48 ECTS of complementos for a non-telecom engineer).
